description: Versioned evaluation specification for independent evaluation of bootstrap candidate revisions, defining 1-to-1 event alignment, property denominators, observability rules, and leakage boundaries.

presence.description: Denominator is all observable reference events within the evaluated contiguous windows.

penalties.missed: FN: reference event has no candidate match within dt_max_ms
penalties.extra: FP: candidate event has no reference match within dt_max_ms

victim.description: Denominator is all matched reference events with non-null ground-truth victim.

penalties.abstained: candidate victim is null (counts against recall/accuracy)
penalties.conflict: candidate victim != reference victim (counts as misattribution)

killer.description: Denominator is all matched reference events with non-null ground-truth killer.

death_cause.description: Denominator is all matched reference events ('gun' vs 'ability' vs 'environmental').

second_life.description: Denominator is all matched reference events involving second-life mechanics (e.g. Phoenix Run It Back).

whole_event.description: Event matched in time and all non-null reference properties correctly asserted without abstention.

observability_criteria.ally_death: Always observable via HUD roster alive-count dimming, minimap death mark, or killfeed entry.
observability_criteria.enemy_death: Observable via killfeed entry or scoreboard row dimming. Non-gun kills outside team vision may have unobservable death location (explicit location abstention permitted).
observability_criteria.abstention_policy: Unobserved or ambiguous properties must evaluate to null with a stored reason code; guessing is forbidden.

source_selection_policy.contiguous_slices: Evaluations must cover contiguous round windows rather than isolated cherry-picked frames.
source_selection_policy.count_agreement_insufficient: Evaluator must enforce 1-to-1 event alignment; matching round totals with duplicate-plus-miss noise is treated as an error.

transfer_partition.rule: Neither Lane B nor any learning pipeline may use session a1a995e6b19b for training, anchor harvesting, or threshold tuning.

leakage_checks.query_instance_exclusion: A query instance and its descendants must not be used to train or retrieve the candidate exemplar.
leakage_checks.anchor_independence: Every learned binding must trace to an independent non-self-derived anchor.
